action: The municipality says it never asks for passwords, account details or payments by phone, SMS or e-mail; as noe.ORF.at reports, anyone who receives such messages should contact the Rathaus or the police.
date_note: Date of the municipality's announcement of dark web monitoring, as published by noe.ORF.at on 21 Nov 2026; the attack itself was at the end of July, per noe.ORF.at on 22 Oct 2026.
exec: A municipality offers dark web monitoring to residents after a July cyberattack affected citizens' data.
plain: The Austrian municipality of Reichenau an der Rax, hit by a cyberattack discovered at the end of July, offers affected people personal dark web monitoring.

summary: noe.ORF.at reports that the municipality of Reichenau an der Rax offers those affected personal dark web monitoring after a cyberattack it says it discovered at the end of July. The municipality says no data was encrypted (eXXpress) and the mayor says it paid no ransom (MeinBezirk). eXXpress reports that SafePay published the stolen data on 10 October and that a register extract in it lists 4171 people.
title: Reichenau an der Rax municipality offers dark web monitoring after cyberattack

validation.note: noe.ORF.at (22 Oct, 21 Nov) and eXXpress (22 Oct) each report the end-of-July attack and the SafePay leak; the dark web monitoring offer is stated only by noe.ORF.at. eXXpress figures come from an analysis by RisikoMonitor; no municipal page read.

review.note: action advice: removed 'be cautious' wording the page does not give, kept the municipality's never-asks statement and report to Rathaus/police; added missing published day on first source; summary, SafePay, 4171 evidence match

evidence.quote: Darin sind 4171 Personen erfasst – 2396 mit Hauptwohnsitz und 1775 mit Nebenwohnsitz in der Gemeinde.
